goal: Prevent fee estimation queries from failing or severely underbidding fees when mempool data is unready
Fall back to block-based fee rate estimates during node startup, sparse mempools, or loading failures
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: General support for falling back to block policy fee rates when mempool policy is unavailable
Concept approval to ensure fee estimates remain available (achow101, polespinasa, sedited)
Reported downstream occurrences in LDK and verified the fix through testing (instagibbs, tankyleo)
Nonblocking objection: helper return types obscure error semantics at call sites (davidgumberg)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because fee queries currently fail or badly underbid market fees when the mempool is sparse or loading
Downstream projects such as LDK encounter missing fee estimates in production during startup or reloads
